image_target.tooltip: Image(s) to apply the color transform to.

image_ref.tooltip: Reference image(s) to match colors to.

source_stats.tooltip: per_frame: each frame matched to image_ref individually. uniform: pool stats across all source frames as baseline, match to image_ref. target_frame: use one chosen frame as the baseline for the transform to image_ref, applied uniformly to all frames (preserves relative differences)

target_index.tooltip: Frame index used as the source baseline for computing the transform to image_ref

ColorTransfer.name: ColorTransfer
ColorTransfer.description: Match the colors of one image to another using various algorithms.

iclora_model.tooltip: Direct output from a LoRA Loader for the specific IC-LoRA from which to extract the metadata.

output_tooltips: IC-LoRA parameters extracted from the LoRA metadata (eg. reference_downscale_factor). Connect to LTXVAddGuide if the LoRA requires special handling of the guides.
GetICLoRAParameters.name: GetICLoRAParameters
GetICLoRAParameters.description: Extracts IC-LoRA parameters from the safetensors metadata of a LoRA-loaded model and outputs them for LTXVAddGuide (eg. reference_downscale_factor).

model.tooltip: The model to add preview override to.

audio_normalization_factors.tooltip: Comma-separated list of audio normalization factors to apply at each sampling step. For example, '1,1,0.25,1,1,0.25,1,1' will apply a factor of 0.25 at the 3rd and 6th steps.

output_tooltips: The model with Audio Latent Normalizing Sampling.
LTX2AudioLatentNormalizingSampling.name: LTX2AudioLatentNormalizingSampling
LTX2AudioLatentNormalizingSampling.description: Improves LTX2 generated audio quality by normalizing audio latents at specified sampling steps.

latent.tooltip: Target video latent the guide is pinned onto.

guiding_latent.tooltip: Guide latent. Its spatial size must divide the target's by the same whole number on both axes; equal size pins it as-is, half size is treated as an x2 IC-LoRA reference.

latent_idx.tooltip: Latent frame index to start the guide at, counted in latent frames rather than pixel frames. Negative values place the guide on frames before the start of the latent, not counted back from its end.

strength.tooltip: Capped at 1.0. A dilated guide marks its padding positions with a negative denoise mask so the model drops them; above 1.0 the kept positions would go negative too and the whole guide would be dropped. Amplify beyond 1.0 with attention_mask instead.

attention_mask.tooltip: Optional pixel-space spatial mask. Controls per-region conditioning influence via self-attention, multiplied by strength.

LTXVAddLatentGuide.name: LTXVAddLatentGuide
LTXVAddLatentGuide.description: Pins an already-encoded latent as a guide, for when the guide comes out of an earlier stage rather than an image. Same effect as LTXV Add Guide without the VAE decode/encode round trip. A guide that is spatially smaller than the target (an IC-LoRA or detailing reference) is dilated onto a sparse grid, and its RoPE end positions are expanded by the same ratio so it covers the target canvas instead of addressing only the top-left corner of it.

audio_vae.tooltip: The Audio VAE model to use for encoding.

LTXVDualCFGGuider.name: LTXVDualCFGGuider
LTXVDualCFGGuider.description: Separate CFG scales for the video and audio modalities of a packed LTXV-AV latent.

latent.tooltip: Video or audio latent to freeze. Audio is 4D; video is 5D.

LTXVFreezeLatent.name: LTXVFreezeLatent
LTXVFreezeLatent.description: Set noise_mask to 0 so this latent is kept clean during sampling. Works on video or audio. Typical uses: freeze audio before Concat AV so it only provides cross-attention, or freeze any latent that should not be denoised.

attention.tooltip: The dense attention backend. Comfy Kitchen attention uses quantized INT8 attention and is available only on Nvidia and AMD GPUs.

refine_iterations.tooltip: SAM decoder refinement passes (0=use raw detector masks)

individual_masks.tooltip: Output per-object masks instead of union

positive_coords.tooltip: Positive point prompts as JSON [{"x": int, "y": int}, ...] (pixel coords)

negative_coords.tooltip: Negative point prompts as JSON [{"x": int, "y": int}, ...] (pixel coords)

object_indices.tooltip: Comma-separated object indices to include (e.g. '0,2,3'). Empty = all objects.

max_objects.tooltip: Max tracked objects. Initial masks count toward this limit. 0 uses the internal cap of 64.

detect_interval.tooltip: Run detection every N frames (1=every frame). Higher values save compute.

initial_mask.tooltip: Mask(s) for the first frame to track (one per object)

conditioning.tooltip: Text conditioning for detecting new objects during tracking

start_index.tooltip: Start time in seconds, can be negative to count from the end (supports sub-seconds).

TrimAudioDuration.name: TrimAudioDuration
TrimAudioDuration.description: Trim audio tensor into chosen time range.

max_duration.tooltip: Maximum duration in seconds; the model can end the song earlier.

MiniMaxMusic3TextEncode.name: MiniMaxMusic3TextEncode
MiniMaxMusic3TextEncode.description: Uses a MiniMax Music3 CLIP model to generate the acoustic conditioning sequence.

EmptyMiniMaxMusic3LatentAudio.name: EmptyMiniMaxMusic3LatentAudio
EmptyMiniMaxMusic3LatentAudio.description: Creates an empty MiniMax Music3 audio latent for the requested duration.

filename_prefix.tooltip: The prefix for the file to save. May include formatting tokens such as %date:yyyy-MM-dd%.

format.tooltip: The file format in which to save the audio.

SaveAudioAdvanced.name: SaveAudioAdvanced
SaveAudioAdvanced.description: Saves the input audio to your ComfyUI output directory.

mask_1.tooltip: Mask for the first speaker, required if using two audio inputs.

mask_2.tooltip: Mask for the second speaker, required if using two audio inputs.

motion_frame_count.tooltip: Number of previous frames to use as motion context.

image.tooltip: First frame to be used for the video.

duration.tooltip: Video duration in seconds. Durations over 10s require a 720p/1080p resolution and 24/25 FPS.

generate_audio.tooltip: When true, the generated video will include AI-generated audio matching the scene.
When true, the generated video will include AI-generated audio matching the scene.

seed.tooltip: Seed to determine if node should re-run; actual results are nondeterministic regardless of seed.

last_frame.tooltip: Last frame to be used for the video.

LtxApi25ImageToVideo.name: LtxApi25ImageToVideo
LtxApi25ImageToVideo.description: Professional-quality videos with customizable duration and resolution based on start image.
